text:
alice: Quick heads-up — PR #3421 is ready but it's noisy because Black reformatted the Python lambda handler and the TS client got linted by prettier/eslint. CI is red and I want to avoid a big churny rebase. Can we do a short exception or a focused fix?
ben: :eyes: linking the PR — I can review the naming nits but not online for another 3h. What's failing CI specifically?
alice: CI Bot shows two failures: lint for frontend (eslint) and a flake8/black mismatch in infra/lambda. buildkite log snippet: `error: cannot format due to line-length mismatch` and `eslint --max-warnings 0` failing.
caro: If black changed a lot maybe the repo had an older line-length. What does pyproject.toml say?
alice: pyproject has `line-length = 88` and pre-commit is pinned to black==22.3.0. The lambda was still using 100 in our local dev config so formatting drifted.
caro: Ok. Two approaches: 1) revert formatting changes in the PR and only keep functional commits, then run a separate cleanup PR for full repo reformat; or 2) ask for a one-off formatter allowance on this PR so it can land with the functional change and we follow up with a reformat PR.
emma: I'm +1 for option 1 unless CI owners are blocked. Reformat PRs are safer. Also pinging @ben as code-owner for the client naming change.
ben: I can approve the naming / logic once I get eyes. If we go option 2 we need to record it (audit) and add a short note in the PR why the reformat is included. Not a fan of mixing both.
alice: Agree. I started splitting commits but two files still show big diffs. My ask: can someone approve a minimal commit that renames the param from `ctx_id` -> `context_id` (backend) and `ctxId` -> `contextId` (TS client)? That rename is the actual functional change. The formatting changes are incidental.
caro: If the rename is atomic and tests cover it, we can land that first. Can you force-push a split with only the rename commit?
alice: Yep, I'll push a reworked PR with only the rename + tests. Keeping the Black/prettier changes out.
ci-bot: buildkite: PR #3421 — queued for retry after force-push.
ben: Also little nit: can we prefer `context_id` over `contextId` in the TS shape when we send to the backend? We've had mixed casing earlier and it caused mapping code. If this PR normalizes that, add a short migration note.
emma: For the TS client, add a small helper `toSnakeCase` call in the client serializer so the backend stays stable for now. That reduces the blast radius.
alice: Good call — I'll add a small serializer fix and unit test.
caro: One more style nit: please don't change the import ordering in the TS file — revert those auto-import reorders. Leaves history cleaner.
alice: will do. Plan: 1) force-push single commit rename + serializer + tests, 2) revert formatting-only edits, 3) open separate PR for repo-wide Black/prettier reformat with a proper changelog and CI run.
ben: Sounds good. If you ping me when it's pushed I'll review quickly.
emma: I'll queue a pre-merge CI run after your force-push so we can get green before merge. :thumbsup:
alice: thanks — pushing now, will ping in thread.
ci-bot: buildkite: rebuild started for PR #3421 (after force-push).
alice: pushed and pinging @ben for review.
ben: Reviewing — left 2 tiny comments (param name docstring + test edge-case). Both optional but nice to have.
alice: addressed both, pushed.
ben: :shipit: approved.
ci-bot: buildkite: all checks passed for PR #3421.
emma: merging once green — thanks for splitting this up, much easier to reason about.
alice: merged and will open the reformat PR tomorrow listing the exact black/prettier version bumps and rationale.
caro: Thanks! Also add a one-liner in the reformat PR about the upgrade to pre-commit hooks so devs get the same toolchain.
alice: will do.
